domain: Enterprise AI Governance, LLM Firewalls & Agentic Workspaces
tagline: AI middleware firewalls, dynamic multi-LLM routing & multi-tenant GenAI workspaces
summary: Architected production-ready enterprise AI governance middleware and multi-tenant SaaS control planes enabling institutions to deploy secure, compliant, and cost-optimized GenAI workspaces with real-time prompt interception, PII redaction, and deterministic policy enforcement.

featuredProjects.name: High-Performance AI Governance Middleware & Security Firewall
featuredProjects.description: Production-ready AI governance decision engine and middleware intercepting 100% of user prompts before reaching LLM providers, enforcing deterministic compliance policies, automated PII masking, and cost-optimized model routing.
highlights: Engineered 8-layer modular governance pipeline: Context Resolver, PII Detector, Deterministic Policy Engine, PolicyLLM Intent Classifier, Decision Engine, Enforcement, and SHA256 Audit Log
Implemented dynamic multi-model routing (cloud vs. local Ollama), slashing LLM inference compute costs by up to 90%
Built hybrid regex + spaCy NER pipeline for real-time redaction of sensitive PII (emails, SSNs, IDs, financial data) in prompts and model outputs
Enforced deterministic policy precedence with granular action enforcement: ALLOW, TRANSFORM, BLOCK, WARN, and ESCALATE

featuredProjects.name: Institutional GenAI SaaS Workspace & Multi-Tenant Control Plane
featuredProjects.description: 3-tier institutional AI operating system and SaaS control plane featuring 21 integrated productivity tools, master administrative control plane, and physically isolated tenant databases for compliant GenAI workspaces.
highlights: Architected hybrid multi-tenant database system featuring a master control plane DB and physically isolated institutional tenant databases
Engineered 12-step automated institutional onboarding wizard covering domain validation, SSO/MFA configuration, and tenant database lifecycle automation
Integrated Redis caching layer achieving 85%+ cache hit rate, reducing cached response times to 50–150ms and cutting database load by 70%
Implemented automated compliance engines adhering to FERPA physical isolation, GDPR data sovereignty, and SOC 2 Type II audit logging

tagline: Multi-tenant digital signage, high-throughput campaign scheduling & device telemetry

Built automated database seeding, health check endpoints, and robust JWT-based tenant authentication
